definitions.gloss: as much as possible, to the extent one can
definitions.explanation: Used to express doing something to the greatest extent that is feasible or within one's ability.

examples.japanese: できる{限|かぎ}り⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please come as early as possible.

examples.japanese: できる{限|かぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧はします。
examples.english: I will cooperate as much as I can.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦ロス→ロス：11223_rosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、できる{限|かぎ}り⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to use ingredients without waste as much as possible to reduce food waste.

notes:
できる{限|かぎ}り is a commonly used expression meaning "as much as possible" or "to the best of one's ability."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦なるべく→なるべく：01281_narubeku⟧: as much as possible (slightly more casual)
- ⟦{可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り→可能な限り：17323_kanounakagiri⟧: as much as possible (more formal)
- ⟦{精一杯|せいいっぱい}→精一杯：13774_seiippai⟧: to the fullest extent, with all one's might

USAGE:
Can modify verbs directly (できる{限|かぎ}り⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧) or be used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns (できる{限|かぎ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧).
